hypothesis.title: Tariff-Related Executive Social Media Posts and Next-Day US Equity and Implied Volatility Reactions
hypothesis.statement: Tariff-related executive posts are followed by abnormal next-session S&P 500 returns or VIX changes.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: Mean next-day |AR|, AR and dVIX on event days equal those on non-event days.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: At least one of the three means differs from the non-event baseline (Bonferroni alpha 0.0167).
hypothesis.methodology: Keyword event study, trailing-mean abnormal returns, placebo resampling
hypothesis.summary_findings: abs_return: event 0.736% vs 0.724% (p=0.772); signed_return: event -0.023% vs 0.026% (p=0.375); vix_change: event 0.810% vs 0.073% (p=0.070)
